## Required

Nine fields: trip ID; vessel name, flag or chartering state, IOTC number and main gear.

Captain and fishing-master names and nationalities complete the required fields.

## Available

All 67 trips in the 2025 selection have vessel and captain links; 66 have a populated vessel IOTC ID.

Crew count is recorded on 17 trips. Names, flag and other identifiers can be read from linked records.

Population does not establish valid ROS registry matches or prove that a person's country means nationality.

## To decide

Resolve vessel/contact matches and missing or conflicting IDs; confirm flag and chartering-state treatment.

Main fishing gear is mandatory but unavailable directly from the checked ObServe data and references.

It must be supplied or confirmed for each trip; Philippe's fixed drifting-longline value is not source data.

**Agreed:** use the trip captain's name and country for both personnel roles throughout the ObServe export.

**IRD proposal:** add a fishing-master person flag and an optional trip link, allowing two distinct people.

Confirm registration country, port and number, licensed targets, and optional identifier mappings.

Reuse the O-INFO trip ID. Do not manufacture missing vessel identifiers.

The database permits an empty sheet; shared vessel details may come from other sheets. IOTC rules remain open.
